objective: Repair BUKLOD Main Wall photo-only posting from iPhone Messenger in-app browser while retaining working Wall video, existing media authorization, optional music/motion and draft safety; prepare source for next consolidated web/OTA release without publishing.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main 5efb99435243a4bcaeff27fc8d41d58b6a9969c2 source baseline on 2026-11-10. Screenshot shows iPhone Messenger direct buklod.expo.app Wall photo publish failure with SYS-500 and composer restored; user reports video succeeds. Existing database RPCs and storage were inspected read-only. Exact production web SHA, failed browser request stack, and device E2E are not independently verified. Owner waived actual-device verification for this candidate; web/Android release gates remain required.
chosenApproach: Preserve original selected web File via picker state through photo signing/upload. Call Expo web picker directly within active user tap instead of awaiting dynamic import/permission no-op. Bypass canvas conversion for ordinary real JPEGs and pass Blob to signed PUT; try bounded Expo conversion then short-lived browser canvas JPEG conversion for other browser-decodable formats. Preserve native/working video path; bound web photo concurrency, retain draft, and keep post commit independent of feed refresh.
selectionRationale: A photo was present in failed composer while video reportedly works, pointing toward photo-specific picker and conversion/upload path. GitHub source reveals unnecessary web-await before file selection, lost asset.file and repeated URI fetch/conversion. Browser file metadata and native fallback maintain content fidelity, reduce memory spikes and avoid speculative database migrations or production configuration changes.
alternativeApproaches: Require users to leave Messenger and open Safari to post photos (rejected: does not fix broken in-app user path)
Upload original HEIC/PNG bytes to .jpg without conversion (rejected: incorrectly labelled media breaks viewer compatibility and data integrity)
Retain video upload, forward web File and safely convert only when necessary; preserve existing Supabase signed PUT and native flow (chosen)
acceptanceChecks: Music and ambiance remain optional for text/photo-only Community Wall posts.
Photo-only and photo+video browser gallery open directly from user gesture without asynchronous web permission checks.
Browser-picked original JPEG File is available to upload without duplicate URI fetch/canvas conversion up to safe bounded size.
Other browser-decodable formats become actual JPEG bytes; unsupported conversions fail visibly without mislabelling or uploading invalid files.
Photo post success does not become a false failure when feed refresh fails; actual failed posts restore composer content.
Web photo uploads are bounded at two concurrent tasks, native and video upload logic unchanged.
Only authorized signed-upload paths used; no new Supabase migration, native package, app version, permission or runtime changes.
Focused Node regression suites cover photo, web picker, optional creative metadata, route/composer and single-flight behavior.
Before consolidated release: TypeScript compile, focused tests, full RC export and exact live-source fingerprint gates must pass; actual physical-device test waived, not represented as successful.
preserveBehaviors: Working video submission, player, AWS routing, native upload and Reel/IGPAT constraints
Existing account-scoped draft restoration, submission deduplication and media storage RLS
Wall text-only post and optional audio/ambiance metadata
Existing scoped/community posting APIs and legacy photo edit flow
Production app and Expo web remain unchanged until separately gated consolidated promotion
